comment: The Gravion model registry — Gravion AI's own model entries and variants. Status 'available' means the registry entry and module/bundle packaging path can be resolved; it does not by itself claim trained weights are included. The weights_status field is authoritative for weights: gravion-core includes local trained embedding/linear weights in data/gravion-core-weights.json (included), trained only from the bundled Gravion corpus (5,657 examples, 779 answer classes), with a deterministic fallback; the specialist entries are packaging-ready registry entries with no trained weights included in this repository (packaging_ready_no_weights). Specialist model behaviour requires an operator-supplied endpoint or a future operations-supplied weights bundle. A deployment may register private variants by placing its own models.json in the deployment home; the same schema and validation apply.

models.name: Gravion Core
models.notes: The built-in local Gravion Core model inside every Gravion deployment. It includes a sparse n-gram embedding + direct linear softmax classifier (10,586,543 parameters counted from stored quantized weights) trained only from the bundled Gravion corpus of 5,657 examples across 779 answer classes, and falls back to a deterministic offline responder when no confident trained match is available. It runs with no network and no API key.

models.name: Gravion Chat
models.notes: Registry and bundle packaging entry for conversational chat/support work. This repository includes no trained weights for Gravion Chat; model behaviour comes from an operator-supplied endpoint or a future operations-supplied weights bundle.

models.name: Gravion Omni
models.notes: All-in-one registry entry covering every capability at the Advanced tier. This repository includes no trained weights for Gravion Omni; the runtime accepts this entry for the all-in-one package, while actual model behaviour comes from an operator-supplied endpoint or a future operations-supplied weights bundle.
